description: Per-database object statistics (pg_stat_user_tables / pg_stat_user_indexes, top by size). Source: ClickHouse pg_monitoring (dual write).

panels.description: No scans over the range, not unique / primary. Use a representative range (full test or ≥ 7 days). last_scan = 1970 means never scanned since stats reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, indexrelname, c_scans_in_range AS scans_in_range, c_scans_total AS scans_total, c_size AS size, c_is_unique AS is_unique, c_is_primary AS is_primary, c_is_valid AS is_valid, c_last_scan AS last_scan FROM (SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, indexrelname, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_scan)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_scan)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_scans_in_range, argMax(idx_scan, time) AS c_scans_total, argMax(index_bytes, time) AS c_size, argMax(is_unique, time) AS c_is_unique, argMax(is_primary, time) AS c_is_primary, argMax(is_valid, time) AS c_is_valid, argMax(last_idx_scan_epoch, time) * 1000 AS c_last_scan FROM pg_monitoring.pg_index_stat WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) GROUP BY db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, indexrelname) WHERE scans_in_range = 0 AND is_primary = 0 AND is_unique = 0

panels.title: Unused indexes

panels.description: is_valid = 0: failed CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, drop and re-create.

targets.rawSql: SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, indexrelname, c_size AS size, c_scans_in_range AS scans_in_range, c_tup_read_in_range AS tup_read_in_range, c_is_unique AS is_unique, c_is_valid AS is_valid FROM (SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, indexrelname, argMax(index_bytes, time) AS c_size, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_scan)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_scan)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_scans_in_range, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_tup_read)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_tup_read)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_tup_read_in_range, argMax(is_unique, time) AS c_is_unique, argMax(is_valid, time) AS c_is_valid FROM pg_monitoring.pg_index_stat WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) GROUP BY db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, indexrelname)

panels.title: Indexes by size

panels.description: Large tables with many rows read by seq scans are missing-index candidates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, c_seq_scans AS seq_scans, c_seq_tup_read AS seq_tup_read, c_idx_scans AS idx_scans, c_live_tup AS live_tup, c_total_size AS total_size, c_last_seq_scan AS last_seq_scan FROM (SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(seq_scan)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(seq_scan)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_seq_scans, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(seq_tup_read)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(seq_tup_read)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_seq_tup_read, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_scan)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(idx_scan)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_idx_scans, argMax(n_live_tup, time) AS c_live_tup, argMax(total_bytes, time) AS c_total_size, argMax(last_seq_scan_epoch, time) * 1000 AS c_last_seq_scan FROM pg_monitoring.pg_table_stat WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) GROUP BY db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname)

panels.title: Seq-scan-heavy tables

panels.description: dead_pct > 10 %: warning, > 20 %: critical. Old last_vacuum with many updates: autovacuum lags.

targets.rawSql: SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, c_dead_tup AS dead_tup, c_dead_pct AS dead_pct, c_mod_since_analyze AS mod_since_analyze, c_upd_in_range AS upd_in_range, c_del_in_range AS del_in_range, c_autovacuums_in_range AS autovacuums_in_range, c_last_vacuum AS last_vacuum, c_last_analyze AS last_analyze, upd_in_range + del_in_range AS upd_del_in_range FROM (SELECT db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname, argMax(n_dead_tup, time) AS c_dead_tup, argMax(dead_tup_pct, time) AS c_dead_pct, argMax(n_mod_since_analyze, time) AS c_mod_since_analyze, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_upd)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_upd)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_upd_in_range, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_del)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(n_tup_del)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_del_in_range, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(autovacuum_count)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(autovacuum_count)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_autovacuums_in_range, argMax(last_any_vacuum_epoch, time) * 1000 AS c_last_vacuum, argMax(last_any_analyze_epoch, time) * 1000 AS c_last_analyze FROM pg_monitoring.pg_table_stat WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND $__conditionalAll(db_instance IN (${db_instance:singlequote}), $db_instance) AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) GROUP BY db_instance, datname, schemaname, relname)

panels.title: Dead tuples and vacuum

options.content:
# Unused / missing indexes

**Symptom.** Slow reads on large tables (missing index) or slow writes / high WAL and storage (too many unused indexes).

**Where to look.** `pg-indexes` → *Unused indexes* table, *Seq-scan-heavy tables* table, *Index size* column.

**How to interpret.**
- Unused index: `spread(pg_index_stat.idx_scan) = 0` over a representative range (a full load test or ≥ 7 days),
  `is_unique = 0`, `is_primary = 0`; `last_idx_scan_epoch` old or 0. Sort by `index_bytes`.
- Missing index candidate: large `pg_table_stat.total_bytes` with high `spread(seq_tup_read)` and
  `spread(seq_scan)` ≫ `spread(idx_scan)`.
- `is_valid = 0` → a failed `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`; the index costs writes but is never used.
- Stats are per database and per instance (replicas have their own counters).

**Likely causes.** Indexes created for old features / ORM defaults, duplicate indexes (same leading columns),
new query patterns without a supporting index.

**Actions.**
1. Unused: confirm on all replicas, then `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY` (keep a rollback script).
2. Invalid: `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY` and re-create.
3. Missing: find the masks touching the table on `pg-statements` → `EXPLAIN` → `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`.

**Related SQL.** `sql/database_index_stat.sql`, `sql/database_table_stat.sql`.

# Autovacuum lag / dead tuples

**Symptom.** Tables and indexes grow without data growth, queries slow down, plans get worse (stale statistics).

**Where to look.** `pg-indexes` → *Dead tuples / vacuum* table (dead %, last vacuum, last analyze).

**How to interpret.**
- `pg_table_stat.dead_tup_pct` > 10 %: warning; > 20 %: critical (default autovacuum threshold is 20 % + 50 rows).
- `now - last_any_vacuum_epoch` large on a table with high `spread(n_tup_upd + n_tup_del)` → autovacuum cannot keep up.
- `n_mod_since_analyze` large relative to `n_live_tup` → statistics are stale → bad plans.
- `pg_activity_grouped` rows with `max_xact_age_s` high → vacuum is blocked by an old transaction
  ([idle-in-transaction](idle-in-transaction.md)).

**Likely causes.** High update/delete rate on big tables with default scale factors, long transactions holding
the xmin horizon, autovacuum throttled (`autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit`), too few workers.

**Actions.**
1. Remove old transactions first.
2. Per-table tuning: `ALTER TABLE ... SET (autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = 0.01, autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor = 0.02)`.
3. Raise `autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit` / workers (parameter group).
4. Manual `VACUUM (ANALYZE)` in a quiet window; `pg_repack` for heavy bloat (DBA).

**Related SQL.** `sql/database_table_stat.sql`, `sql/cluster_activity_grouped.sql`.
